fields.options: Rewrites the literal app_title = "..." and (if given) app_logo_url = "..." lines inside that app's own hooks.py file, on the server's filesystem - not a Translation record, and not Website Settings (which doesn't drive the app switcher / About screen's per-app logo - this does). Applies the moment you save, and re-applies automatically after every bench migrate (so a bench update that resets these files gets fixed again on the next migrate, no extra step needed). Only those two lines are ever touched - App Name (the internal Python/import identifier every doctype, permission and module reference depends on) is never modified.

fields.description: Turn this one rule off without deleting it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The app's internal Python name exactly as it appears in sites/apps.txt (e.g. "frappe", "erpnext", "hrms") - never changed, only used to locate that app's hooks.py.
fields.label: App Name (internal, unchanged)

fields.description: What app_logo_url should read instead - a path served under /assets/..., e.g. /assets/branding/images/tijarat-logo.png. Leave blank to leave the app's logo alone.
fields.label: New Logo URL
